shared_elements: human figure in low relief on stone
carved relief motifs organized in horizontal registers/bands
justification: Both are stone reliefs featuring human forms and some horizontally banded arrangement of carved motifs, and both include a plain incised disc, but these are generic correspondences. A shows long processional friezes of many small profile figures in file, leading animals and carrying objects across stacked registers, whereas B is a single monolithic frontal human bust with a huge stylized head and a few isolated schematic emblems (rings, crescent-like arcs, a ring-and-band motif) scattered over the back — no procession, no interaction between figures, and utterly different proportions and scale conventions.
